headline: Galy, Planet A take on cocoa; Oobli sugar replacer; FDA salt-substitute rule; UPF pressure
summary: Cocoa alternatives are going commercial: Galy launched cell-cultured cocoa chocolate in the US and to professional kitchens, and Planet A Foods released a high-fibre Cocoa Booster powder that replaces part of the cocoa; Belcolade should evaluate both as partners and competitors.

FDA will let salt substitutes be used in 139 standardized foods, including breads and rolls, from December 14, 2026, giving bakery customers a clear sodium-reduction path and Puratos a sell-in moment.
Pressure for a federal ultra-processed food definition and a tighter GRAS process keeps building, so prepare clean-label, fewer-additive options and audit US ingredient dossiers now.

Oobli and Cosun's sugar replacer for chocolate, plus MOA Foodtech's egg-replacement partnership with Espiga, are start-up moves to benchmark against Puratos sugar-reduced chocolate and egg-free cake solutions.
Fibre is the main NA bakery reformulation theme, with Grupo Bimbo, Calise and Rudi's adding fibre and protein, which supports Puratos fibre and protein enrichment solutions.

items.title: Planet A Foods Unveils One-Ingredient Cocoa Powder Alternative to Cut Costs & Capture GLP-1 Market
items.summary: German cocoa-free chocolate start-up Planet A Foods launched Cocoa Booster, a single-ingredient, high-fibre powder that partly replaces cocoa powder to cut costs, pitched at GLP-1 users.
items.why: A ready cocoa-powder extender from the leading cocoa-alternative start-up: a partnership or competitive benchmark for Belcolade and cocoa-saving fillings.

items.title: Planet A Foods targets cocoa costs with high-fiber Cocoa Booster
items.summary: Planet A Foods' Cocoa Booster is a high-fibre ingredient that replaces part of the cocoa in recipes to offset cocoa costs.
items.why: Cocoa-cost relief with a fibre claim is a direct competitor to Belcolade cocoa-saving solutions; consider evaluating or partnering.

items.title: Planet A Foods expands with advanced cocoa powder replacer
items.summary: Planet A Foods is expanding its range with a cocoa powder replacer.
items.why: Planet A Foods moving from chocolate into cocoa powder replacement widens its overlap with Belcolade and patisserie fillings; a partnership target.

items.title: Roquette unveils new hydrocolloid ingredient for improved gluten-free baked goods
items.summary: Roquette has launched a new hydrocolloid ingredient designed to improve the texture of gluten-free baked goods.
items.why: A large ingredient competitor entering gluten-free bakery texture; benchmark it against Puratos gluten-free mixes and improvers.

items.title: Palsgaard launches powder-based cake gel alternative to cut waste and simplify production
items.summary: Palsgaard launched a powder-based alternative to cake gel emulsifiers that reduces waste and simplifies production.
items.why: A direct competitor move in cake emulsifiers and improvers; benchmark against Puratos cake mixes and cake improvers.

items.title: Andfoods Rolls Out Fermented Black Gram Whipped Cream in Singapore
items.summary: New Zealand start-up Andfoods, a Riddet Institute spin-out, launched a dairy-free whipped cream made from fermented black gram protein in Singapore foodservice.
items.why: A fermented-legume whipped cream already in professional kitchens is a partnership or benchmark for Puratos plant-based whipped toppings.

items.title: The Effect of Storage Conditions on the Properties of Sourdough Starters, Mature Sourdoughs and Quality of the Bread
items.summary: A Wrocław University study found rye sourdough starters can be refrigerated at 4 °C for up to 144 h without changing mature sourdough acidity or loaf quality, though taste declined at the longest storage.
items.why: Practical starter-storage guidance Puratos can pass to artisan customers using Sapore and live sourdough, and a cue for stable-starter positioning.
entities: Wrocław University of Environmental and Life Sciences

items.title: Trump Weighs Ultra-Processed Food Definition
items.summary: The White House is reportedly weighing a federal definition of ultra-processed food.
items.why: A federal UPF definition would hit packaged bread, cakes and confectionery; keep clean-label, fewer-additive reformulation options ready for US customers.

items.title: Small Changes, Big Impact for Craft Bakers
items.summary: Bake magazine feature on clean-label dough improvers that help artisan bakeries work more efficiently and cut waste.
items.why: Clean-label improvers for artisans are core S500 territory; check which suppliers are featured as competitive context.

items.title: A variety of fiber options meet various baking needs
items.summary: Trade article reviewing fiber sources, including fruit and vegetable fibers like pumpkin and blueberry, for different baking applications.
items.why: Confirms NA demand for consumer-friendly fibre sources, supporting Puratos fibre-enrichment solutions.

items.title: Revyve Unveils Yeast Ingredient to Enhance Alternative Proteins Amid Whey Crisis
items.summary: Dutch start-up Revyve launched a yeast protein ingredient to replace whey in alternative-protein products at lower cost.
items.why: Revyve's functional yeast proteins (also used as egg replacers) are a partnership candidate for egg- and dairy-free cakes and fillings.

items.title: Revealed: What consumers want from an artisan bakery
items.summary: British Baker survey of what consumers want from artisan bakeries.
items.why: Consumer expectations for artisan bakeries feed Taste Tomorrow insight and Puratos artisan customer support.

items.title: Lindt CEO exit: Strategic reset or overreaction?
items.summary: Lindt replaced its CEO as chocolate makers shift from price-led growth to recovering consumption volume.
items.why: Signals the premium chocolate sector is turning to volume recovery, relevant to Belcolade's demand planning and customer innovation pitch.

items.title: Pro Tip: Understanding the science of layer integrity in laminated dough
items.summary: Technical tip on the science of layer integrity in laminated dough and a quality protocol to get light, layered products.
items.why: Laminated-dough quality is a Puratos viennoiserie support topic; useful content for technical advisers.

items.title: Interactive map: Tracking state food chemical regulation in the U.S.
items.summary: EWG published an interactive map tracking US state laws on food chemicals and additives.
items.why: State additive and dye laws create a patchwork for US bakery and confectionery customers; use the map to check product compliance by state.

items.title: A flavour to watch: The rise of pandan
items.summary: Pandan is gaining traction as a sweet, green, functional flavour that may follow matcha.
items.why: An emerging flavour for cakes, fillings and glazes; a candidate for Taste Tomorrow-led patisserie launches.
